name: What is the process for replacing multiple windows with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing multiple windows with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with a free, no-obligation consultation at your home to assess your needs and provide a detailed estimate. Once you approve the quote, we order custom-sized windows. Upon arrival, our skilled team handles the removal of old windows, prepares the openings, installs the new windows, ensures proper sealing and insulation, and completes any necessary trim work. We conclude with a thorough cleanup and final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves a home consultation, custom window ordering, professional installation including removal, preparation, sealing, and trim work, followed by cleanup and inspection.
